Hi,

I'm interested in ordering the Hammer BC04 Beginner Pack with the Overclocking Bundle for delivery to Norway. (https://heliumdeploy.com/products/beginner-pack-hammer-bc04-overclocking)

Your product page states “Import VAT included in price – Ships from within EU.”

Could you please confirm the following?

1. Does the price include **Norwegian VAT (25%)**, rather than VAT from another EU country?
2. Will the order be delivered to Norway with all applicable import taxes and customs clearance charges prepaid, so I won't have to pay anything extra to Posten, DHL or Norwegian Customs?
3. Will the shipment be declared correctly for Norwegian import procedures?

I'd appreciate confirmation that the advertised price plus shipping is the final amount payable.

Thank you.
Read the beginner pack hammer bc04 overclocking page
Handed to the team · Norway is outside the EU VAT area; the page's EU VAT line doesn't cover it and I

Straight answer: that VAT line is for EU-member destinations, and Norway is outside the EU VAT area. So no — the $254.14 does not include Norwegian 25% VAT.

Shipping to Norway is an export. Norwegian import VAT, any duty, and the carrier's clearance fee are charged to you on delivery by Posten or DHL; we don't prepay them at checkout. Price plus shipping is what we collect, not the final landed cost.

On the declaration itself — I've put your question to Georges so he confirms the export paperwork and terms in writing. The team is offline until 10am ET today; the answer comes to (email hidden)
you can message me back when avaialble at (email hidden) Thanks

Will do — Georges will reply to that address today.

Before you go, one thing: if the Norwegian import charges land where you expect, is the BC04 pack a done deal, or are you still weighing other units?
yes then might think of other mining bundle deals below 3000 kr including shipping, fees, etc to norway since VAT rules for anything above 3000 nok is different and often endup at very higher sides
Searched the catalog · bitcoin miner bundle beginner pack

Smart framing. Here's what fits under that line, live prices today:

The B. Pack is $254.14 and the bare BC04 is $249 — the pack adds the $59.99 Overclocking Bundle for about five dollars, so it's the better buy of the two. Shipping to Norway runs from $21.99 (rest-of-Europe bracket). That puts you around $276 landed value, roughly 2,800–2,900 NOK depending on the day's rate — under 3,000, but not by a wide margin.

Cheaper headroom if you want distance from the threshold: Hammer Thor X1 at $219 (3.2 TH/s, 46 W, no PSU — it's USB-C) or the Bitaxe Supra Hex 703 at $229 (4.2 TH/s, 90 W).

What I can't promise is which declared value and rate Norwegian customs applies on the day. Georges will cover that with the paperwork answer.
